title: Hearthline Discovery Surface Allocation
description: A member-directed allocation of which shared-activity options appear on the member's discovery surface, in a member-chosen presentation mode. No ranking, scoring, or penalty semantics are permitted.
$comment: Forbidden fields include rank, weight, compatibilityScore, engagementScore, visibilityPenalty, reducedAccessScore, safetyScore, riskScore, responseTimeWeight, photoQualityScore, popularity, distance, proximity, or coordinates.
